checkoutRecovery.verifying: We’re verifying your purchase. There’s no need to repeat it.
checkoutRecovery.storageFailed: We couldn’t save your purchase on this device, so we didn’t send it. Free up space and try again.
checkoutRecovery.pending: Your payment isn’t confirmed yet. We’ll update your order when the bank responds. There’s no need to pay again.

mobileAccess.notConfigured: This version of the app is not set up to verify the device.
mobileAccess.serverNotConfigured: Mobile app verification is not available yet. You can shop on the web store.
mobileAccess.deviceUnsupported: We could not verify this device. The app requires a phone that supports Google Play or Apple verification; you can keep shopping on the web store in your browser.
mobileAccess.planNotIncluded: This store's current plan does not include the mobile app (available on the Pro plan). You can shop on the web store, including from your phone's browser.
mobileAccess.storeUnavailable: The saved store is no longer available or its current plan does not include the mobile app.

offline.showingCopy: data saved on {{date}}; prices and stock may have changed
offline.requiresConnection: This action requires an Internet connection.
offline.purchaseRequiresConnection: You need a connection to buy: price and stock are confirmed with the store at that moment. Your cart is still saved.

profile.offlineHint: You can change your first and last name: they are saved on this phone and sent when the connection returns. Email and password require a connection.
profile.willSyncOnline: it will be sent when the connection returns
profile.willSyncSoon: it will be sent in a few seconds
profile.needsLogin: Your change is still saved on this phone. It will be sent when you sign in again with this same account.
profile.conflictDescription: While you were offline, this data changed from another device. Choose which value to keep; nothing is overwritten without your decision.
profile.resolveFirst: Resolve the conflict shown above first.
profile.savedOffline: No connection: your change will be sent automatically when the connection returns.
profile.savedOnline: We are sending your change to the server.
profile.emailRequiresConnection: Email can only be changed online and with no pending changes.
profile.logoutPending: You have profile changes that were not sent. They will stay on this phone and be sent when you sign in again with this account.

tryOn.title: Live try-on
tryOn.garmentHint: The catalog photo of the item is used as the reference.
tryOn.before: When you tap “Start”, the front camera opens and the video is sent to Decart, the service that transforms it in real time. You need an Internet connection. The microphone is not used and the store does not record or keep the video. Each try-on lasts at most {{seconds}} s.
tryOn.disclaimer: The video is an AI-generated visual simulation. It does not guarantee how the size or the actual fit will look on you.

stage.idle: Tap “Start” and stand in front of the camera, full body if you can.
stage.connecting: Connecting to the try-on… you will see the item on you in a few seconds.

ended.user: Try-on finished. The camera is off.
ended.limit: The {{seconds}} s maximum was reached. The camera is off.
ended.background: The try-on was closed because the app went to the background.
ended.offline: The try-on was closed because the Internet connection was lost.

errors.cameraDenied: No permission to use the camera. Enable it in your phone settings to use the live try-on.
errors.cameraUnavailable: The front camera could not be opened. Close other apps using it and try again.
errors.nativeMissing: The live try-on needs the installed version of the app (development build). It does not work inside Expo Go.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again to use the try-on.
errors.plan: The virtual try-on is not included in this store’s plan.
errors.notEnabled: The virtual try-on is not enabled in this store.
errors.garmentUnavailable: This item is no longer available in the store.
errors.garmentNoImage: This item has no reference photo, so it cannot be used in the try-on.
errors.garmentImageUnavailable: The reference photo of this item is not compatible (it must be an accessible JPG, PNG or WebP). It cannot be used in the try-on.
errors.garmentImageTooSmall: The reference photo of this item has too low a resolution for the live try-on.
errors.busy: You already have a try-on session open. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.storeBusy: This store’s try-on is busy. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.hourlyLimit: You reached the hourly limit of try-on sessions.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.timeout: The try-on took too long to respond. Check your connection and try again.
errors.offline: The live try-on needs an Internet connection. Connect and try again.
errors.network: Could not connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.provider: The try-on service did not respond correctly. Try again.
errors.providerCredits: The try-on is not available right now (service out of credit). Let the store know.
errors.policy: The try-on service closed the session under its usage policies.
errors.token: The try-on authorization expired before connecting. Check that your phone’s date and time are automatic and try again.
errors.connectionLost: The connection to the try-on was interrupted. The camera was turned off; try again.
errors.mismatch: The session received does not match this item or your account, so it was not opened. Try again.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.
errors.clockSkew: Your phone’s date and time are not correct. Turn on automatic time in settings and try again.
